newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary cenbank launches 12-month deposit facility.
newsitem.headline: Hungary cenbank launches 12-month deposit facility.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said on Monday that it was launching a 12-month deposit facility at an annual 20.50 percent interest rate.
The NBH earlier today raised the rate at which it accepts deposits from the commercial banks for six months to 21.00 percent from 20.75 percent.
The move to raise six-month deposit rate surprised the market and dealers and analysts said it was aimed at protecting savings and did not signal an end to repo rate cuts.
